technical.summary: Mixed signals with short-term trend indicators bullish but price trapped below key moving averages and Ichimoku cloud; lacks confluence for high-probability entry.

fundamental.summary: LUV shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 17 days creating elevated event risk.

sentiment.summary: Extreme market fear (31 Fear Greed score) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but congressional activity is absent and stale (6+ months old sales), limiting conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: VIX in crisis territory (355.36), flat yield curve signalling recession risk, rising USD pressuring industrials, CPI event in 2 days, and earnings binary in 17 days create compounded downside risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Short-term trend indicators (supertrend, PSAR, Hull) are bullish and price sits near support (33.6157) in extreme fear environment (VIX 355.36), offering contrarian entry with defined risk.
debate.key_bear_argument: Price is trapped below all key moving averages (EMA/SMA 21 and 50), Ichimoku cloud, with negative momentum (CMF, AO, falling RSI), zero fundamental conviction, high earnings risk in 17 days, and severe macro headwinds (VIX crisis, flat yield curve, USD strength, CPI in 2 days) create compounded downside risk that overwhelms short-term bullish technicals.
